lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted
sections_in_order: Position Statement (general; Blepharoplasty; Blepharoptosis Repair; Brow Lift; NOTE)
criteria_location: Position Statement pp.1-3: a general restore-function sentence, then four procedure subsections each with its own list and its own 'does not meet the definition of medical necessity when performed' cosmetic exclusion. A trailing '*NOTE' on visual field testing exemptions follows the brow lift list. Documentation hints are in the LOINC table after the statement.

logic.top_level: pathways (blepharoplasty upper = ANY of six indications; lower = one indication; blepharoptosis = ALL of five; brow lift = BOTH of two)

k_of_n.quote: Unilateral or bilateral upper eyelid blepharoplasty meets the definition of medical necessity to correct obstruction of central vision when performed to correct ANY of the following

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: A repeated cosmetic exclusion under each procedure: 'does not meet the definition of medical necessity when performed: For cosmetic purposes or to correct deformities resulting from previous cosmetic surgery, OR Solely to improve appearance in the absence of signs and symptoms of functional abnormalities'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Unilateral or bilateral upper eyelid blepharoplasty meets the definition of medical necessity to correct obstruction of central vision when performed to correct ANY of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The lead-in says 'to correct obstruction of central vision' but the ANY list includes prosthesis difficulty, thyroid sequelae, nerve palsy and trauma, none of which is about central vision. It is unclear whether central-vision obstruction is a separate requirement for each item.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Before taping, the superior visual field is 20 degrees or less, AND After taping, the superior visual field is increased 30% or more
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: '20 degrees or less' is an absolute field extent; '30% or more' is a relative increase, base unspecified (30% of what: the 20 degrees, or of the normal field?). Units mix degrees and percent.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Visual field testing performed with and without taping that demonstrates
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The visual-field and photograph requirements apply only to the last (interference with vision) item; a parser that attaches 'documentation must include' to the whole ANY list will over-require.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: The margin reflex distance (MRD) between the pupillary light reflex and the upper eyelid skin edge is ≤ to 2 mm
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Definitions say MRD is measured to the 'eyelid margin' (and 'corneal light reflex or center of the pupil'); criterion says 'upper eyelid skin edge'. Eye (right/left) not specified.

vague_terms.problem: No functional test required at all for this item despite the 'obstruction of central vision' lead-in.

extraction_hazards: Bulleted lists with 'AND' / 'OR' trailing on lines; nested bullets 'o' and small squares flatten.
Footnote-style '*NOTE' appears after the brow lift section but applies to all visual field requirements.
'ANY of the following' with a documentation sub-list that applies to only one item.
Typo in description ('tightening the he levator muscle').
LOINC table repeated cell text; page navigation tabs in header.
interesting_structures: Visual-field thresholds in two units (degrees for baseline, percent for improvement).
Blepharoptosis requires both field loss AND MRD <= 2 mm; blepharoplasty does not require MRD.
Explicit exemption path when the visual field test cannot be done (severe tremors, macular degeneration, physical deformities, glaucoma).
Many etiology-based indications that skip field testing (anophthalmic socket, thyroid, nerve palsy, trauma).

fit_to_tree.why: ANY-of indications over ALL-of measurement bundles; clean except for the lead-in vs list mismatch, mixed units and one inline exemption.
